query: PD-L1 IgV minibinder design target and RFdiffusion3 hotspot setup
summary: Selected PD-L1 IgV domain from PDB 5JDS chain A crop 18-134 because it is a compact, previously used binder-design target. Use RFD3 hotspots A56,A115,A123 from existing ProteinClaw GPU test guidance; target crop has 115 residues and no gap inside 18-134 after crop filtering.
